entries.title: The Thing

emulation.emulator: Native remaster on PC and modern consoles; PCSX2/xemu only for original console copies
emulation.notes: Use the remaster for normal play. Use original hardware or emulation only for historical comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Nightdive remaster on PC with 4K/high-frame-rate support.

primary.why: The Nightdive remaster is the definitive version because it faithfully restores the 2002 survival-horror shooter for modern platforms with remastered visuals, antialiasing, per-pixel lighting, 4K resolution, and up to 120 FPS support.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Thing: Remastered on Steam or GOG and play on a modern Windows PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a faithful remaster/restoration of the 2002 game, not a remake or a new sequel.
